scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic potential proof and explicit rational four-jump cycle; finite rational tests reproduce examples but do not replace universal proof. Bibliographic originality remains subject to independent priority checking.
scientific_limitations: One vacancy, complete multipartite graph, fixed type totals, identical utilities within each type and graph part, and occupied closed-neighborhood self-inclusion. The length bound is polynomial only for fixed part/type counts. The two-vacancy cycle does not prove every multiple-vacancy instance cycles.
title: Exact potential and a sharp vacancy boundary for single-peaked jump games on complete multipartite graphs
